create_ControlNetXSAdapter_from_unet: create a ControlNetXSAdapter from an existing UNet2DConditionModel using from_unet class method
create_UNetControlNetXSModel_from_unet: create a UNetControlNetXSModel by fusing a UNet2DConditionModel with a ControlNetXSAdapter
run_UNetControlNetXSModel_forward: run the forward pass of UNetControlNetXSModel with noisy sample, timestep, and conditioning input
freeze_UNetControlNetXSModel_unet_params: freeze the base UNet parameters in UNetControlNetXSModel leaving only adapter weights trainable
enable_UNetControlNetXSModel_freeu: enable the FreeU mechanism on UNetControlNetXSModel up blocks with scaling factors s1, s2, b1, b2
